name: Amaterasu Hirume Mikoto
original_name: アマテラス=姫 神琴
source:
The Sixth Seat of the "Seventh Chord". Mikoto was accepted into the "Seventh Chord" at the same time as [url=https://vndb.org/c14209]Freya[/url]. An energetic young woman who likes to boast about her three sacred treasures of the current generation: "alcohol", "smartphones", and "getting what she wants when she pleads in tears". As the eldest of the three-man cell, she is usually the one to stop Freya's reckless charging to battles with Alicia's help. Mikoto has a very bright, bold, and carefree personality. She is also well-known as a troublemaker. Although she is a beautiful woman, Mikoto has a very frank personality that it makes it hard for her friends to dislike her. 

In battle, Mikoto uses three "unique" sacred treasures that her mother created for her. Like the scorching fire of the Sun represented by her name, she specializes in manipulating fire magic. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=853983]Getchu[/url]]
